summary: Federal Communications Commission urges preservation of E-Rate program to ensure broadband access for schools and libraries, citing cost and infrastructure needs.

claims.argument: Removing E-Rate would eliminate critical funding for schools' broadband infrastructure
claims.evidence_quote: Placer Co Office Of Education has received $560,918 in committed federal E-Rate support over funding years 2021–2025 — an average of roughly $112,184 a year toward the connections our students depend on. That support does not represent a one-time build; it is the recurring cost of keeping a modern network running.
